{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data with proper parsing of revenue
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any non-numeric entries
non_numeric_revenue = sales[sales['revenue'].isna()]
print(f"Number of rows with non-numeric revenue: {len(non_numeric_revenue)}")

# Check the first few rows after conversion
display(sales[['revenue', 'channel']].head())"}
